decisions.reason: As a newly launched drainage product with its own dedicated page, it appears strategically supported and too early in its life cycle for a conservative German building-products firm to withdraw.
Floor-level shower drainage fits durable market demand in modern and barrier-free bathrooms, so despite lighter website emphasis the firm would likely continue backing it.
A designer shower drainage line with its own page matches the premium bathroom segment and is likely seen as worth retaining beyond the first year.
This shower element complements the firm's shower drainage offering, and such system products are usually kept long enough to build installer adoption.
The backflow-protected basement floor drain addresses a clear technical problem and was explicitly presented as a developed solution, making an early withdrawal unlikely.
